keyLimits.en: Up to 5 users, 1 schedule, 1 escalation policy, 100 SMS/phone notifications per month.
Annual billing at $252/user/year (about 16% discount vs monthly); includes enhanced chat and post-incident reviews.
$2,800/year platform fee, 10 seats, 5,000 Signal Intelligence events, 5,000 AI actions, 1 Live Call Routing line.

cautions.en: PagerDuty now sells two distinct product lines: legacy per-seat Incident Management (Free/Professional) and the newer PD Reliability Platform priced as an annual platform fee with seat and usage caps; do not mix the two pricing models when comparing.

capabilities.en: Real-time incident management with on-call scheduling and automatic escalation policies.
AI-assisted operations: SRE Agent can detect, triage and diagnose incidents before waking a human (Spring 2026 release).
Integrates with over 700 native applications and supports MCP plugins (e.g. for Claude Code, Cursor).
Works across web, mobile and chat-ops surfaces so teams can respond where they already work.

limitations.en: Free tier is capped at 5 users, 1 schedule and 1 escalation policy, unsuitable beyond a very small team.
The newer PD Reliability Platform tiers are usage-capped (events, AI actions) and largely quote-based above the entry tier.

reason.en: Competes directly for incident management, on-call and uptime alerting for smaller teams.
Overlaps for monitoring and alerting workflows that feed into incident response.
Used for error/incident alerting in a similar on-call workflow, though more developer-error focused.
